name: Vietnamese Name Database (Tu dien Ho Ten trong Viet Nam)
note: Vietnamese given names, which no statistics office publishes. Vietnam registers births
but does not release name frequencies, and Wikidata has none tagged to Vietnamese --
fifty-seven surnames and no given names at all. Without this, `vi` draws Vietnamese
surnames and English given names, which reads as a bug to anyone Vietnamese.
A community compilation rather than a register, and it is taken on the same reasoning
as `cities-json` and `airport-data`: the names themselves are facts about a language,
the compilation is MIT, and the alternative was nothing.
What it therefore does not carry is weights. Every other given-name source here is a
population count, and a weighted draw reaches a common name far more often than a rare
one. This is a list of names that exist, so it ships unweighted -- the same decision
`az-adlar` records, and for the same reason: giving every entry an equal invented
weight would encode a uniform draw as though somebody had measured it.
Pinned per file rather than as a repository tarball, and that is deliberate. The
repository also holds `uit_member.json`, 1.6 MB of what appear to be real university
members. Naming the four list files individually means the roster is never fetched,
never cached and never in a position to be read by mistake, which is a stronger
guarantee than choosing not to parse it.
Pinned to a commit rather than to `master`: the repository is actively maintained, and
a moving reference is not a pin.
